identification.summary: A Microsoft Threat Intelligence Podcast episode titled "Threat Landscape Update on Grandoreiro and Luna Tempest" (Episode 20) was published on 2024-06-05 [S2][S3]. Microsoft's "Tempest" naming family denotes financially motivated actors [S1].
identification.notes: No standalone Microsoft blog post or vendor report on Luna Tempest was found in open search. Do not merge with Octo Tempest (Scattered Spider) or Luna Moth (Silent Ransom Group); no source found links them to Luna Tempest.

attribution.basis: Microsoft's Tempest naming family denotes financially motivated actors [S1]. No state or criminal-group attribution found in sources.

campaigns.summary: Microsoft's podcast published an episode titled "Threat Landscape Update on Grandoreiro and Luna Tempest" on 2024-06-05. Only the title and date were verified; the episode description and content could not be opened [S2][S3].

gaps: No Microsoft blog, report or other primary technical reporting on Luna Tempest was found in about 6 searches.
Podcast show notes (S3) reportedly describe Luna Tempest as a US/UK-based extortion group; this was seen only in a search summary, not verified on the page, and is not used here.
Sectors, regions, TTPs, tooling, infrastructure, campaigns and first-observed date are all unknown from open sources gathered.
Possible relationship to other named clusters (Octo Tempest, Luna Moth, Grandoreiro operators) is unverified.
